## Motivation

Today the multimodal processor turns text into a prompt string, lets the HF processor expand
media placeholders in that string, and tokenizes the result. RL rollouts and multi-turn sessions
already hold the exact token IDs of the conversation; re-tokenizing them from text can change
those IDs. Token-space processing keeps the caller's input_ids and expands media placeholders
directly in token space.

## Modifications

- `mm_token_expansion_start_len` on `GenerateReqInput` and `ChatCompletionRequest`: the length of
  an input_ids prefix to leave untouched (for example earlier turns whose media are already
  expanded). Validated and normalized per batch item.
- `--enable-token-space-processor` server option (off by default). Nothing reads it yet; startup
  wiring comes in a later PR. It is rejected with `--encoder-only` / `--language-only` for now:
  the EPD receiver still expands placeholders with each processor's `get_mm_data`, which does
  not honor `mm_token_expansion_start_len`.
- `expand_token_placeholders`: replaces each placeholder pattern after the start length with its
  media fragment, keeping the prefix and never rescanning inserted tokens.
- `TokenSpaceProcessStrategy`: per-model hooks that process one media item at a time
  (`process_image` / `process_video` / `process_audio`) and assemble the per-item fields
  (`merge_*_features`), plus `expand_media_tokens`, which tokenizes when no input_ids are given
  and expands placeholders with the model's expansion spec, and `build_processor_output`, which
  returns the same `BatchFeature` keys as the HF processor (`input_ids`, `attention_mask`, the
  media features, and `mm_token_type_ids` when the processor defaults ask for it).
- The mixin gains `load_and_process_token_space_async`, the token-space counterpart of
  `processor(text, media)`: it loads media with the shared loader, processes one task per item
  on the processor workers, expands placeholders and returns that `BatchFeature`. Training and
  serving both call it. `TokenSpaceMMProcessor` is a trainer-side host that needs no server.
- The per-item CUDA memory pool, the move of features to CPU and the device rule now live in the
  mixin, so a trainer that passes a CUDA device gets the same handling as serving. The first two
  commits move the defaults and the two transfer helpers from the base processor (the second is
  a mechanical move with a proof). Serving keeps only its own default device
  (`_fast_image_processor_device`) and derives `keep_mm_features_on_device` from its feature
  transport; a trainer sets it through `MultimodalProcessorConfig`.
- `BaseMultimodalProcessor.process_token_space_mm_data_async`: the serving entry. It calls
  `load_and_process_token_space_async`, then `sglang_post_process` collects the items, binds them
  with the existing `_bind_and_finalize_mm_items`, and each model builds the final
  `MultimodalProcessorOutput` in `_build_mm_output`. Models opt in through
  `token_space_process_strategy_class`; none does in this PR.
- Media URL policy: a `MultimodalProcessorConfig` that leaves the domain list or the size limit
  unset keeps that part of the process-wide policy (`preserve_allowed_domains`, and
  `max_file_size_mb=None` in `configure_media_url_security`), so a trainer host never resets
  limits it did not set. Existing callers pass both values and are unchanged.

No serving behavior changes: no model sets a strategy and the option is not read yet.

Follow-up: `get_mm_data` / `build_input_ids` is a second hand-written copy of the HF expansion rules
on the EPD receiver. The strategy only needs grids and timestamps, so the receiver can reuse it in a
later PR, which also lifts the EPD restriction above.

## Tests

- test_mm_token_expansion_start_len.py: request field validation and batch normalization.
- test_server_args.py: the option is rejected with --encoder-only and --language-only.
- test_mm_token_expansion.py: expansion rules (prefix kept, counts checked, no rescan) and the
  serving path with a fake processor (offsets, source configs, decoder cleanup).
- test_media_url_security.py: a trainer host keeps or overrides the process policy as configured.
- test_processor_device_selection.py, test_mm_utils_split.py: device choice and item split for
  the token-space path.

## Stack

Part 4 of a 6-PR stack; this PR is based on #43422 and only shows its own commits. Review and merge in order.

| Part | PR | Title |
|---|---|---|
| 1/6 | #43420 | Move multimodal enums to a shared module |
| 2/6 | #43421 | Initialize multimodal processors from a processor config |
| 3/6 | #43422 | Extract a shared media processor mixin |
| 4/6 | #43423 | Add token-space multimodal processing **(this PR)** |
| 5/6 | not opened yet | Add a token-space strategy for Qwen VL models |
| 6/6 | not opened yet | Enable token-space processing at startup with parity tests |

+"""Expand media placeholders without decoding the caller's token IDs."""
+
+from collections import Counter, defaultdict
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+
+
+def expand_token_placeholders(
+    input_ids: Sequence[int],
+    mm_token_expansion_spec: list[tuple[Sequence[int], Sequence[Sequence[int]]]],
+    mm_token_expansion_start_len: int = 0,
+) -> list[int]:
+    """Expand suffix placeholders using trailing media fragments, preserving the prefix.
+
+    Args:
+        input_ids: Original token IDs containing the prefix and suffix to process.
+        mm_token_expansion_spec: Ordered (nonempty pattern, full-conversation fragments in media order) rules; first match wins.
+        mm_token_expansion_start_len: Unchanged prefix length in [0, len(input_ids)]; defaults to 0.
+
+    Returns:
+        A new token ID list with the suffix expanded; inserted tokens are not rescanned.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(mm_token_expansion_start_len, int) or not (
+        0 <= mm_token_expansion_start_len <= len(input_ids)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("mm_token_expansion_start_len must be in [0, len(input_ids)].")
+
+    patterns_by_first_token = defaultdict(list)
+    for rule_index, (pattern, _) in enumerate(mm_token_expansion_spec):
+        if not pattern:
+            raise ValueError("Token expansion patterns must not be empty.")
+        patterns_by_first_token[pattern[0]].append((rule_index, tuple(pattern)))
+
+    # TODO: Optimize pattern matching with an Aho-Corasick automaton.
+    matches = []
+    position = mm_token_expansion_start_len
+    while position < len(input_ids):
+        for rule_index, pattern in patterns_by_first_token.get(input_ids[position], ()):
+            if tuple(input_ids[position : position + len(pattern)]) == pattern:
+                matches.append((position, rule_index))
+                position += len(pattern)
+                break
+        else:
+            position += 1
+
+    match_counts = Counter(rule_index for _, rule_index in matches)
+    fragment_indices = []
+    for rule_index, (pattern, fragments) in enumerate(mm_token_expansion_spec):
+        match_count = match_counts[rule_index]
+        if match_count > len(fragments) or (
+            not mm_token_expansion_start_len and match_count != len(fragments)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Found {match_count} placeholders for token pattern {list(pattern)}, "
+                f"but received {len(fragments)} media expansions"
+            )
+        fragment_indices.append(len(fragments) - match_count)
+
+    expanded_input_ids = []
+    cursor = 0
+    for position, rule_index in matches:
+        pattern, fragments = mm_token_expansion_spec[rule_index]
+        expanded_input_ids.extend(input_ids[cursor:position])
+        expanded_input_ids.extend(fragments[fragment_indices[rule_index]])
+        fragment_indices[rule_index] += 1
+        cursor = position + len(pattern)
+    expanded_input_ids.extend(input_ids[cursor:])
+    return expanded_input_ids

+def list_media_items(
+    *,
+    images=None,
+    videos=None,
+    audios=None,
+    image_source_configs=None,
+    video_source_configs=None,
+    audio_source_configs=None,
+    video_metadata=None,
+):
+    """Flatten loaded media into (modality, item, source_config, item_kwargs) in modality order."""
+    media_items = []
+    for modality, loaded_media, source_configs in (
+        (Modality.IMAGE, images, image_source_configs),
+        (Modality.VIDEO, videos, video_source_configs),
+        (Modality.AUDIO, audios, audio_source_configs),
+    ):
+        loaded_media = loaded_media or []
+        if source_configs is not None and len(source_configs) != len(loaded_media):
+            raise ValueError("Source configs must align with the loaded media list")
+        for index, item in enumerate(loaded_media):
+            item_kwargs = {}
+            if modality == Modality.VIDEO and video_metadata is not None:
+                item_kwargs["video_metadata"] = video_metadata[index]
+            source_config = source_configs[index] if source_configs else {}
+            media_items.append((modality, item, source_config, item_kwargs))
+    return media_items

+def close_loaded_media(media_items):
+    """Release decoders opened by loading once every item has been processed."""
+    for _, item, _, _ in media_items:

+            try:
+                item.close()
+            except Exception:
+                logger.warning("Failed to close a loaded video decoder", exc_info=True)

+def concat_media_features(features):
+    """Concatenate tensors along dim 0 and chain lists, field by field, in item order."""
+    return {
+        name: (
+            torch.cat([feature[name] for feature in features])
+            if isinstance(features[0][name], torch.Tensor)
+            else [value for feature in features for value in feature[name]]
+        )
+        for name in features[0]
+    }

+class TokenSpaceProcessStrategy:
+    """Prepare native media fields one item at a time and expand placeholders in token space."""
+
+    media_processor_kwargs_type = None
+
+    def __init__(self, hf_config, processor, *, mm_process_config=None):
+        self.hf_config = hf_config
+        self._processor = processor
+        mm_process_config = mm_process_config or {}
+        self.image_config = mm_process_config.get("image", {})
+        self.video_config = mm_process_config.get("video", {})
+        self.audio_config = mm_process_config.get("audio", {})
+
+    def resolve_media_options(
+        self, processor, *, image_device=None, video_device=None, **kwargs
+    ) -> dict:
+        """Resolve each modality's processor options once per request."""
+        kwargs.setdefault("return_tensors", "pt")
+        kwargs.setdefault("padding", True)
+        kwargs_type = (
+            self.media_processor_kwargs_type or processor.valid_processor_kwargs
+        )
+        processor_kwargs = processor._merge_kwargs(
+            kwargs_type,
+            tokenizer_init_kwargs=processor.tokenizer.init_kwargs,
+            **kwargs,
+        )
+        image_kwargs = processor_kwargs["images_kwargs"]
+        video_kwargs = processor_kwargs["videos_kwargs"]
+        audio_kwargs = processor_kwargs["audio_kwargs"]
+        image_kwargs.update(self.image_config)
+        video_kwargs.update(self.video_config)
+        audio_kwargs.update(self.audio_config)
+        if image_device is not None:
+            image_kwargs["device"] = image_device
+            video_kwargs.setdefault("device", image_device)

+            if "device" in kwargs_type.__annotations__["audio_kwargs"].__annotations__:
+                audio_kwargs.setdefault("device", image_device)

+            video_kwargs["device"] = video_device

+            Modality.IMAGE: image_kwargs,
+            Modality.VIDEO: video_kwargs,
+            Modality.AUDIO: audio_kwargs,
+        }

+    def process_item(
+        self, modality, item, processor=None, source_config=None, **options
+    ) -> dict:
+        """Process one loaded media item into its own native fields."""
+        processor = self._processor if processor is None else processor
+        source_config = source_config or {}
+        process_modality = {
+            Modality.IMAGE: self.process_image,
+            Modality.VIDEO: self.process_video,
+            Modality.AUDIO: self.process_audio,
+        }[modality]
+        return process_modality(item, processor, source_config, **options)
+
+    def merge_media(self, media_items, item_features) -> BatchFeature:
+        """Assemble per-item fields, in item order, into one native BatchFeature.
+
+        A modality with one item keeps that item's fields as they are, so the
+        merge_*_features hooks run only for two or more items and must leave a
+        single item unchanged.
+        """
+        features_by_modality = {}
+        for (modality, *_), features in zip(media_items, item_features):
+            features_by_modality.setdefault(modality, []).append(features)
+        media_features = BatchFeature()
+        for modality, features in features_by_modality.items():
+            merge_modality = {
+                Modality.IMAGE: self.merge_image_features,
+                Modality.VIDEO: self.merge_video_features,
+                Modality.AUDIO: self.merge_audio_features,
+            }[modality]
+            # A single item needs no assembly; returning it avoids a copy.
+            modality_features = (
+                features[0] if len(features) == 1 else merge_modality(features)
+            )
+            duplicate_keys = media_features.keys() & modality_features.keys()
+            if duplicate_keys:
+                raise ValueError(

+                )

+

+    def build_processor_output(
+        self,
+        media_features: BatchFeature,

+        """
+        processor = self._processor if processor is None else processor

+            self.media_processor_kwargs_type or processor.valid_processor_kwargs

+            kwargs_type,

+            data.pop("video_metadata", None)

+                                         member.merge_media -> BatchFeature
+                                                          |

+partly expanded IDs + boundary -> suffix matcher -> IDs    |
+                                                    |     |
+                              Base.sglang_post_process <--+
+                                        |
+                     collect -> full offsets -> serving split

+raw media -> media list loader -> bare media, prompt untouched

+Loaders retain the original source types and call-level sampling rate.
